Company description:
Epiroc is a leading productivity partner for the mining, infrastructure and natural resources industries. Withcutting-edge technology, Epiroc develops and produces innovative drill rigs, rock excavation and constructionequipment, and provides world-class service and consumables. The company was founded in Stockholm,Sweden, and has passionate people supporting and collaborating with customers in more than 150 countries.
Job description: Join our team   
As a Production Quality Engineer, you play a key role in shaping the quality, reliability, and safe performance of our products. You will be at the forefront of ensuring that every product leaving our production facilities meets and exceeds customer expectations, while contributing to a safe, efficient, and world-class manufacturing environment. 
 This is more than a quality role. It is an opportunity to make a visible impact on our products, processes, and future technologies. By driving quality excellence and safety improvements, and reducing disturbances throughout the production flow, you will directly influence customer satisfaction, operational performance, and business success. 
 Your mission 
 In the role as Production Quality Engineer, you will contribute and support the organization to exceed customer´s expectations with safe products and components with the right quality and highest reliability.  
 You will inspire and contribute to efficient and disruption-free production from a safety and quality perspective. Cross-functional collaboration with several different departments regarding quality issues.
   
Be part of and contribute to the daily work and improvement work within the Production Quality department. 
 
    
Advanced troubleshooting during quality disturbances with a high focus on new technology e.g. electrification.  
 
    
Investigate and forward feedback. 
 
    
To be a case holder during advanced quality deviations and perform root cause analysis. 
 
    
Develop and review quality processes. 
 
    
In connection with quality outcomes from field, product audits and testing. Evaluate, educate, implement and follow-up on improvements. 
 
    
Takes ownership to prevent future deviations using risk analyses, Lean principles, create and manage data collection and 6 sigma methodology. 
 
    
Perform module inspection. 
 
  
 Your profile
 To thrive as a Quality Engineer, you are a team player capable of handling multiple tasks simultaneously. Your curiosity about new technology and a thoughtful and structured approach allows you to think innovatively and show initiative. Flexibility is key, and you enjoy building and maintaining an extensive network both internally and externally. A service-oriented mindset is second nature to you, and you see stimulating tasks as opportunities rather than limitations.  
   
You have a technical university degree or equivalent work experience and a strong interest in technology.  
 
    
Proficiency in the Microsoft Office suite, especially Excel and Word, 
 
    
Experience working in M3 and Teamcenter, along with other quality tools, is highly desirable.  
 
    
With excellent proficiency in both Swedish and English, spoken and written, you can communicate smoothly within our global network.  
 
  
 
 Your experience in quality and assembly, coupled with in-depth knowledge of our products, makes you an ideal candidate for the role. 
  
 Location and other 
 This position is located in Örebro, Sweden. Occasional travel is required.  
  
 Why Epiroc? 
 By joining our team, you’ll make a big difference in the energy transition. At Epiroc, we take pride in being passionate innovators, driving the change toward a brighter future for both people and the planet. Guided by our values of Collaboration, Commitment, and Innovation, we foster a culture of trust, growth, and lasting impact. 
  
 To support your journey, we offer a competitive Total Rewards Package, including:  
   
Global career opportunities 
 
    
Learning & Development programs 
 
    
Benefits package, including variable compensation (bonus) 
 
    
Flexible work culture promoting balance and well-being 
 
    
Global Parental Leave Policy 
 
  
 
 Application and contact information 
 We encourage you to submit your application through our online career site as soon as possible, but no later than December 3. Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis, and the position may be filled before last application date.
 For questions about the position, please contact: 
 Hiring Manager, Gustav Scholander, Gustav.scholander@epiroc.com 
 Recruitment specialist, Martin Liljeholm, martin.liljeholm@external.epiroc.com 
  Please note that due to regulations, we cannot handle applications received through email.

A Snapshot of Your Day
By managing the progress of Problem Solving under complex boundary conditions, this position as a Product Integrity Program Manager / Project Manager for Technical Issues is very challenging. In your role, you will have a high visibility to the upper management and the opportunity to grow and to develop your own skills.
How You’ll Make an Impact
Responsibility for planning and managing prioritized projects to ensure effective and timely fleet-wide issue resolution
Coordination of the complete issue-resolution process, from defining clear problem statements and conducting root cause analyses to validating and implementing sustainable technical solutions
Leadership and alignment of all relevant cross-functional interfaces across the organization to maintain project progress and successfully resolve complex technical challenges
Development and execution of risk mitigation strategies, as well as coordination of internal and external communication related to ongoing projects and technical issues
Creation, maintenance, and monitoring of project plans, milestone schedules, and project budgets to ensure successful project delivery
Promotion of continuous improvement through lessons learned, quality feedback to engineering teams, prevention of issue recurrence, and participation in or support of customer meetings worldwide as a technical partner to the commercial project organization

What You Bring
Diploma in Mechanical Engineering or in a comparable field 
Several years of experience within the industrial gas turbine industry or a related technical business environment 
Knowledge about commercial projects and power plant business 
Proven experience as a Program Manager or Project Manager, including leadership of multidisciplinary project teams
Training or certificate in Project Management is meritorious
Strong self-motivation and ability to easily navigate through ambiguity
Good skills in talking and reading English.

About the Team
Join an open and dynamic team where professional and personal development is high on the agenda! You will be part in a team consisting of 5 colleagues, located in Sweden and United Kingdom.
Our Gas Services division offers Low-emission power generation through service and decarbonization. Zero or low emission power generation and all gas turbines under one roof, steam turbines and generators. Decarbonization opportunities through service offerings, modernization, and digitalization of the fleet.
We can offer you employment benefits such as: reduction of working hours, advance vacation, health care allowance and an eventual possibility to a flexible working place.
Who is Siemens Energy?
At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100,000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation. 
Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation. 
Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo
Our Commitment to Diversity
Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity, we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.
Application
Don’t hesitate – apply via https://siemensenergy.avature.net/internalcareers , id nr 308032 not later than 2026-12-21.
Ongoing selection is applied, the role might be filled before last application date.
We refrain from all contact with staffing and recruitment companies, or advertising brokers.
For questions about the role, please contact the recruiting manager Alessio Bonaldo on Alessio.bonaldo@siemens-energy.com 
For questions about the recruitment process please contact the responsible recruiter Hannah Lütgenau on hannah.luetgenau@siemens-energy.com

Are you a back-end developer who enjoys building software that connects with real-world industrial hardware – from forklifts in warehouses to charging systems in ports? Do you like being involved in the full journey, from problem definition to production, and care about creating open, secure and reusable solutions? Then we have a great opportunity for you.
We make electrification of the industry a reality.
Micropower is an international company headquartered in Växjö, Sweden. With strong in-house expertise, we develop and produce efficient, intelligent lithium-ion batteries, charging systems, and power converters. We operate in Sweden, the USA, Germany, Finland, Italy. 
What you'll do 
In this role you design and implement scalable back-end services in Python and Go, and model and optimise data in MongoDB. You build the services and APIs that connect our cloud platform with physical energy hardware in the field. Our services are primarily containerised, and you help deploy, monitor and maintain our self-hosted systems. You own features end-to-end and collaborate across functions with product, sales and support.
You will join a small, product-driven team developing open, secure solutions for the energy industry. With open source at the core of everything we build, we prioritise transparency, reusability, integrity and adherence to open standards. As we are a small team, you will also support other areas which gives you a great opportunity to widen your competence.
The GET team builds and operates the GET Fleet Management System – a containerised cloud and mobile platform that connects to physical energy hardware. The team works closely with Product, Sales and Service to drive the development of open-source energy solutions.
The position is based in Växjö and you will report to Global Software Manager. 
What you’ll get 
A key role in a fast-growing, innovative company where your creativity and ideas have a real impact.  
A dynamic, development-driven environment with great opportunities for professional growth.  
Collaboration across functions, in an international environment. 
Work with cutting-edge technology in a culture that values initiative, collaboration, and continuous learning.

Requirements:
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science/IT or equivalent demonstrated work experience
Around 3–6 years of experience building cloud-based software in a production environment
Solid experience with Python and/or Go in a production environment
Practical experience with MongoDB or other document databases, including data modelling, indexing and scaling
Experience designing and building APIs and back-end services
Experience deploying and maintaining self-hosted systems (Docker, Kubernetes or similar container orchestration; configuration management; monitoring and logging)
Professional proficiency in Swedish and English, both written and spoken

We also value
experience with React or other modern front-end frameworks
experience with IoT, device communication or systems that integrate with hardware

Who you are
A person who is genuinely interested in programming, high-quality results, and maintainable code. You are driven and curious, and you take ownership of your work from problem to production. You enjoy a small, autonomous team and care about the experience your work creates for the end user. Transparency in communication with colleagues across functions – including people outside engineering – is a given for you, and you value open standards and reusable solutions. Change motivates you and you welcome challenges. You solve problems by communicating with others, driving your own development and delivering good results.
Our core principles of presence and responsibility guide us as we progress with dedication and sincerity.  At Micropower we fuel people to power growth. 
Join us in the exciting journey to a more sustainable future!
Application
Please note that we don’t accept cover letter. We kindly ask you to thoroughly answer the questions about requirement for this position instead. You will find them when you click “Apply”.  
The position is based at our office in Växjö, Sweden, and requires a valid Swedish work permit.  
We look forward to hearing from you! 
Micropower had a revenue of approximately SEK 1.8 billion in 2025 and employs 600 people across various departments. For more information about us, please visit www.micropower-group.com (https://micropower-group.com/sv/).  
Form of employment: Permanent employment.

jobs.occupation: Senior Associate – Legal and Business Affairs - Media and Entertainment Law
jobs.description:
Senior Associate – Legal and Business Affairs - Media and Entertainment
Jefferson Saleh is a boutique legal and business affairs consultancy (organised as a Swedish juristbyrå) serving the UK media, entertainment and creative industries. We advise across the full lifecycle of creative content, from development and financing to production, exploitation and licensing, including talent deals, IP strategy, clearances and generative AI. We also provide legal operations and back-office support.
Our clients are primarily based in the UK and US and range from creators and talent to production companies, agencies, financiers and international studios, across film, television, digital, branded and emerging media. 

The Role 
We are seeking an experienced English-qualified solicitor to advise clients primarily on film and TV development and production. The role is suitable for a service-minded candidate who is comfortable leading complex talent negotiations with UK and US talent agents and lawyers, managing high-profile client relationships and advising on production, financing, talent and commercial matters. The candidate should enjoy solving unconventional problems, have a healthy appetite for risk and want to help shape a small but growing consultancy.
The successful candidate will work with a high degree of autonomy alongside senior client stakeholders, producers, financiers, talent representatives and other client legal teams, often across multiple jurisdictions. 

Our Values 
We prioritise speed, quality, trust, commercially meaningful advice and long-term relationships. How we work matters as much as the work itself. Our clients operate in fast-moving environments and expect responsive, available and pragmatic advisers who understand both the legal and commercial sides of a deal. 

Day-to-Day Responsibilities 
Managing the production legal workflow: drafting, reviewing and negotiating talent (writer, director, producer) agreements, PSAs, development and format agreements, finance documentation, distribution and licensing deals, crew and HOD contracts, rights acquisition and chain of title documentation, brand partnership and sponsorship arrangements and other copyright-based agreements.  
Advising on: financing structures, guild and collective bargaining agreements, broadcasting code clearance, production risk, cultural tests and tax incentives 
Managing: transactions and negotiations from inception to delivery 
Acting as: a day-to-day contact for clients and counterparties 
Supporting: business development initiatives 
Supervising: junior lawyers and/or trainees where appropriate

Essential Minimum Requirements  
Qualified solicitor in England & Wales (Australian or US qualified considered if experienced working in the UK market)
At least 5 years’ PQE working with transactional entertainment/media law, primarily advising film and television clients
Experience independently managing film/TV production legals 
Excellent grasp of contractual risk allocation 
Private practice experience or a desire to work in a client-facing role
Understanding of the practical applications of Pact, Equity and BECTU rules
Excellent written and spoken legal English

Desirable Experience 
Understanding of how the UK guild landscape interacts with SAG, WGA and DGA
Understanding of US studio practices and priorities
Ability to negotiate against LA-based acting talent representatives
Working on studio or SVOD commissioned production legals 
Production financing and security arrangements 
AI issues affecting the entertainment industry 
Understanding of GDPR and Data Privacy laws

 
About You  
Proactive and capable of taking ownership
Commercially pragmatic and solutions-focused 
Collaborative and team-oriented 
Interest in the entertainment industry 
Puts clients’ needs first 

Working Arrangements
Full-time in Härryda, Gothenburg, Sweden.

Salary
Gross SEK 60,000–79,000 per month. Where an offer sits within the range will depend on a number of factors, including PQE, depth of film and TV production experience, US talent negotiation experience, level of guild understanding, ability to work without supervision, any existing client relationships and the level of responsibility the successful candidate is able to take on from day one.

Other Benefits
Occupational pension (tjänstepension) 
Private health insurance
Bicycle scheme via salary exchange (förmånscykel)
Discretionary annual bonus scheme
Salary top-up during parental leave based on years of service 
Wellness allowance (friskvårdsbidrag) at or near the tax-free maximum
25 days’ paid annual holiday plus Swedish public holidays
Paid professional annual practising certificate renewal with the SRA 

Öppen för alla
Vi fokuserar på din kompetens, inte dina övriga förutsättningar. Vi är öppna för att anpassa rollen eller arbetsplatsen efter dina behov.

The opportunity
We’re looking for a motivated individual to join our Marketing and Logistics Team. If you're passionate about customer service and operational excellence, this role offers a dynamic environment where you’ll manage offer, order, processing, fulfilment, dispatch, and payment support. You’ll play a key role in ensuring smooth order flow and high customer satisfaction through timely and accurate execution.
Step into the heart of cutting-edge power technology at Hitachi Energy’s High Power Laboratory in Ludvika, Sweden. The Laboratory is a large test facility for high voltage products with a variety of non-routine electrical and mechanical test procedures. Its main purpose is to perform high quality testing, both in the development of new products, and in certification of the products for the global market. The laboratory is accredited by SWEDAC as an independent testing body for many different standards and norms.
This position is with placement in Ludvika, Sweden.
How you’ll make an impact
Management of requests and services to internal and external clients, ensuring a seamless experience from offer to delivery.
Ensure accuracy and timeliness of offers by reviewing incoming requests for completeness, entering them promptly, monitoring progress, and resolving issues in line with company standards to maintain high customer satisfaction.
Support customers with entering requests, processing, and fulfillment, making sure all steps are handled accurately and efficiently.
Assist with order-related documentation, including invoicing and payment follow-up, to support smooth financial transactions.
Continuously look for ways to improve offer, order, invoicing and logistics handling processes and contribute to a culture of operational excellence.
Manage the logistics and drive the project involving the new logistics center.
Contribute to enhance SAP processes in the laboratory based on previous experience.
Be a part of the implementation of the IT system LIMS, which is used to manage laboratory processes and lab data.

Your background
A degree in business administration, logistics, supply chain management, or a related field is preferred.
Previous experience in marketing, order management, logistics coordination, or customer service within a technical or industrial environment.

In this role, you will manage recruitment across technical, creative, and business roles, working closely with hiring managers and our HR Manager to bring great people into our teams.

Working closely with the HR Manager to align recruitment priorities with business needs.

Maintaining accurate and up-to-date recruitment systems, documentation, and reporting.
Identifying and driving improvements to recruitment processes, tools, and ways of working.

Experience independently managing end-to-end recruitment processes.
Experience sourcing and approaching candidates, including for specialist roles.
The ability to build strong relationships with hiring managers and act as a trusted recruitment partner, adapting your communication to different roles, perspectives, and levels of the organisation.
Sound judgment when assessing candidates and supporting hiring decisions.
Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.
A structured and proactive approach, with the ability to manage several recruitment processes and shifting priorities.
Curiosity and a willingness to learn about different professions, technologies, and teams to understand what makes someone successful in each role.

Experience recruiting across technical, creative, and business disciplines.

Proficiency in Swedish.

Real influence, ownership, and opportunities for personal and professional growth.
Wellbeing benefits, including a wellness allowance and regular in-office massages.

At Alstom, we understand transport networks and what moves people. From high-speed trains, metros, monorails, and trams, to turnkey systems, services, infrastructure, signaling and digital mobility, we offer our diverse customers the broadest portfolio in the industry. Every day, 80,000 colleagues lead the way to greener and smarter mobility worldwide, connecting cities as we reduce carbon and replace cars.
 
 
Could you be the full-time  Traction Electrical Design Engineer in Västerås we’re looking for?
 
Your future role
Get on-board and apply your expertise in a new cutting-edge field. You’ll report to the Head of Converter Electrical Engineering, and work alongside collaborative and driven teammates.
 
As a Traction Electrical Design Engineer, you will drive and support technical investigations and collaborate with many different functions within engineering, manufacturing and suppliers to deliver smart, innovative propulsion products to customers all over the world. In this role you will be responsible for design circuit diagrams and create Routine test documentation, define interfaces, analyze costumer requirements, support routine test activities related to this area. Plan and coordinate the work related to circuit diagram design and routine test documentation. As a converter electrical design engineer, you must have a passion for bringing both people and all the technical details together. In this role you will have the opportunity to be part of all phases in the product life cycle from design to final validation, and field support once our products are delivered to customers.
 
We’ll look to you to:
Design circuit diagrams and create routine test documentation for our traction products. Plan and lead the work of a small project team of engineers both onsite and offsite related to circuit design and routine test documentation.
Drive and support technical investigations and design activities related to the circuit design and routine test scope for products in development and in the field.
Define electrical interfaces.
Collaborate with and support system engineering, manufacturing engineers and test engineers.
Analyze customer requirements
As part of the development team, perform one or more of the following development activities, design circuit diagrams, create test documentation, support routine test activities, support prototype and pre-series in production.
Support product lead with bid support, analyzing requirements from customers or system architects and translate them into requirements related to the circuit diagram design routine test for the converter product.
Support other functions, colleagues with reviews.

 
 
All about you
We value passion and attitude over experience. That’s why we don’t expect you to have every single skill. Instead, we’ve listed some that we think will help you succeed and grow in this role:
Degree in Electrical Engineering, Higher Vocational Education specialized in Electric Power or equivalent education
Some experience in relevant field of electrical engineering (Tracion engineering, Circuit diagram design)
Knowledge of E3 (circuit diagram tools) is desirable.
Experience of planning, coordination or leading a smaller team onsite/offsite is an advantage.
English, business fluent, is mandatory for this role and Swedish is an advantage

 
Things you’ll enjoy
Join us on a life-long transformative journey – the rail industry is here to stay, so you can grow and develop new skills and experiences throughout your career. You’ll also:
Enjoy stability, challenges and a long-term career, free from boring daily routines
Collaborate with transverse teams and helpful and humble colleagues
Contribute to innovative projects
Steer your career in whatever direction you choose across functions and countries
Benefit from our investment in your development, through award-winning learning
Benefit from a fair and dynamic reward package that recognizes your performance and potential, plus comprehensive and competitive social coverage (life, medical, pension)

 
You don’t need to be a train enthusiast to thrive with us. We guarantee that when you step onto one of our trains with your friends or family, you’ll be proud. If you’re up for the challenge, we’d love to hear from you!
 
 
 
Important to note
As a global business, we’re an equal-opportunity employer that celebrates diversity across the 70+ countries we operate in. We’re committed to creating an inclusive workplace for everyone.

Software Engineer – Join Us in Building the Future of Dairy Farming at DeLaval
 
Are you a software developer who enjoys solving real-world problems with clean, scalable code? Do you want your work to have a meaningful impact beyond the screen? At DeLaval, we’re looking for a technically driven and collaborative Software Developer to join our cross-functional team developing DeLaval Plus – our digital platform supporting modern dairy farmers around the world.
 
Role and responsibilities
In this role, you’ll work closely with Product Owners, Project Managers, Scrum Masters, UX Designers, QA Engineers, and other developers to build and maintain the frontend and backend services powering the DeLaval Plus website. You’ll be involved in the entire feature lifecycle – from design and development to testing, deployment, monitoring, and incident handling.
 
You will build and evolve functionality that supports our users in their daily work. You’ll help shape robust, secure, scalable, and observable services using modern, cloud-native technologies. This role is ideal for someone who’s excited to deliver reliable systems at scale, enjoys working with data-intensive applications, and is passionate about making a difference in the lives of real users.
 
What You’ll Be Doing
Design, build, and maintain services for DeLaval Plus
Collaborate with a cross-functional team to deliver high-quality features end to end
Write secure and testable APIs following OWASP and clean code principles
Manage infrastructure and deployments using modern IaC and DevOps tools
Work on data-heavy services that are central to our platform’s performance and reliability
Monitor services in production, respond to incidents, and continuously improve system resilience
Contribute to our culture of learning and knowledge sharing

 
Qualifications
We’re looking for someone with at least 7 years of software development experience. You should also have a solid foundation in computer science, with strong knowledge of frontend and backend development.
 
You also have hands-on experience with most or all of the following:  
Languages & Runtime: JavaScript, TypeScript, Node.js, npm
Cloud & Infrastructure: AWS (Lambda, S3, DynamoDB, RDS, VPC), CDK, Kubernetes, Terraform
Architecture & Patterns: REST API development, API security (authentication, authorization, OWASP best practices), event-driven architecture
Testing & Quality: Jest (unit testing), Cypress (E2E), JMeter (load testing), SonarQube
DevOps & Observability: Git, CI/CD pipelines, Docker, Grafana, Loki, Sentry, OpsGenie
Best Practices: Clean code, secure coding, code reviews, production monitoring, incident response
Special Focus: Experience working with data-intensive and high-traffic applications
Computer Science Fundamentals: Algorithms, data structures, system design

 
Who You Are
You’re not just a developer – you’re a team player and a problem solver. We believe you’ll thrive here if you: 
Take responsibility for your work and follow through
Have strong technical curiosity and a drive to continuously learn
Are proactive and enjoy taking initiative
Value collaboration and helping others succeed
Have experience handling incidents and working with customer service to improve production systems
Have worked with production-grade systems and understand the importance of qu ality, reliability, and supportability
Are fluent in English (required) and preferably also in Swedish
Are able and willing to work from our Tumba office at least 3 days per week

 
Additional information
This is a full-time position based at DeLaval’s headquarters in Tumba, south of Stockholm. We offer a hybrid workplace model, combining on-site work with flexibility to work remotely. Apply today and help us shape the future of farming. 
 
Contact
Hiring manager: Sara Neander Bjorklund, sara.neanderbjorklundext@delaval.com
Recruiter: Mathias Gunnstedt, mathias.gunnstedt@delaval.com
About DeLaval
Our vision is to make sustainable food production possible. As a company built on innovation, we constantly work to find ways of helping our customers, dairy farmers, do more with less by providing world-leading milking equipment and solutions. 
 
Today, DeLaval has approximately 4,900 passionate professionals operating in more than 90 markets around the world. DeLaval is part of the Tetra Laval Group. 
 See more at corporate.delaval.com

The department is one of the largest and most specialized units within gastroenterology and hepatology in the Nordic region. It provides both emergency and elective care and works closely with several highly specialized disciplines.
You will become part of an international team of approximately ten specialist physicians with diverse professional backgrounds and areas of expertise. Collaboration, knowledge sharing, and continuous development are central to the department's culture.
The unit manages a broad spectrum of hepatology cases, including advanced liver disease and liver transplantation, while maintaining a strong focus on clinical excellence, education, and research.
Your role

Assess, diagnose, and treat patients with complex liver diseases
Participate in both outpatient and inpatient hepatology care
Work closely with multidisciplinary teams involved in advanced liver treatment and transplantation
Contribute to teaching and supervision of junior colleagues and medical students
Participate in quality improvement initiatives and departmental development
Take part in on-call duties together with experienced colleagues

Qualifications
We are looking for a candidate who has:
EU-recognized specialist certification in Gastroenterology and Hepatology
At least five years of experience working as a specialist physician
Experience in hepatology and management of advanced liver diseases
Experience related to liver transplantation
Strong communication skills in English and a willingness to learn Swedish
The ability to work both independently and collaboratively in a multidisciplinary environment

Research experience, academic involvement, or a PhD is considered an advantage.
Why work here?
This opportunity combines highly specialized medicine with an excellent quality of life.
The region offers:
Easy access to coastlines, nature, and outdoor activities
A vibrant cultural scene and excellent public services
International connections and modern infrastructure
A safe and family-friendly environment
Excellent opportunities for long-term professional development

You will work in a progressive healthcare setting where innovation, education, research, and high-quality patient care are closely integrated.

Ongoing support from a recruiter before, during, and after your employment
Assistance with obtaining Swedish authorization and specialist approvals
Help with relocation, accommodation, and support for your family if needed
Access to a free language course with a private tutor via Teams/Skype

Take the next step in your career

Don’t hesitate to contact me. I look forward to hearing from you and helping you find the perfect job that matches your experience and ambitions.
 
Application

Role Summary
The Outlet Manager runs day-to-day operations at Uma's Momo, a fast-casual restaurant and take-away in Gothenburg, as we prepare to open our next location. The role goes beyond running a single outlet: the successful candidate will build structured, practical ways of working that support both our current restaurant and our next location, focused on guest issue resolution, demand-based staffing, delivery-order handling, learning from incidents, quality checks and coaching, guest feedback, and training new staff. We are looking for a calm, methodical problem-solver with a strong focus on the guest experience and the ability to turn feedback and data into improvements on the floor. We have seen strong traction since opening, and being able to start immediately is a big plus.
Key Responsibilities
●     Develop and own a guest issue-resolution procedure that classifies complaints and incidents by severity (for example, an allergen reaction is critical and a wrong order is minor), sets out what staff can resolve on the spot (such as a free remake or refund) and what is escalated to the manager, and ensures every case is logged and reviewed
●     Build and manage staff rotas around expected demand, including lunch and dinner peaks, keeping labour cost on target, adjusting staffing in real time, and sharing staff between locations while the next location gets established
●     Set clear, rule-based handling for delivery and online orders, including missing items, late deliveries and refund claims, so that cases are resolved quickly and consistently
●     Go beyond completing HACCP logs: when a food-safety check fails (for example, a temperature reading), investigate the root cause and put corrective and preventive actions in place so it does not recur
●     Carry out regular service and food-quality spot checks using simple scorecards, and use the results to coach staff
●     Monitor Google and delivery-app reviews, reply to guests, and turn patterns into fixes
●     Train new staff to our service and food-safety standards ahead of the next opening
●     Interpret sales, food, labour and waste figures in our dashboards, and act on them
●     Lead daily outlet operations, including opening and closing, front-of-house service, kitchen coordination, HACCP and hygiene standards, and supplier ordering and stock control
 Required Skills and Profile
●     Master’s degree or equivalent in Business, Management, Hospitality or similar
●     Experience in operations, customer service or hospitality, including handling escalated customer complaints (international experience acceptable)
●     Fluent in English. Fluency in Nepali strongly preferred.
●     Experience in staff scheduling or demand-based workforce planning
●     Experience writing customer-issue procedures and investigating recurring problems
●     Experience training and coaching teams, including running quality checks
●     Ability to read and interpret dashboards and reports on sales, costs and performance
●     Root cause analysis or Six Sigma experience is an advantage
●     Understanding of food‑safety principles and willingness to undertake required certifications
 
Additional Information
The role combines managerial and hands-on operational work. Hours will be irregular, including evenings and weekends. A salary review will be conducted after 6 months post-probation, or upon meeting agreed performance milestones.

The opportunity
As a Senior Application Engineer for HVAC Offshore Wind, you will join a global team shaping reliable, stable, and high-quality power systems. Working closely with customers, consultants, and cross-functional teams, you will understand challenges, develop optimized solutions, and support growth aligned with our Grid & Power Quality Solutions and Service (GPQSS) strategy.
You will act as a trusted technical advisor, influencing technology direction, customer engagement, and business development activities across AC Offshore Wind applications. The role also includes building competence in offshore wind configuration optimization to support future market growth.
This position is based in Västerås or Stockholm, Sweden, or Mannheim, Germany.
How you’ll make an impact
Engage early with customers to understand power systems needs, identify opportunities, and build long-term relationships with focus on technology and optimization of OSW configurations.
Support Business Development and Sales teams in developing HVAC Offshore Wind solutions tailored to customer requirements.
Develop optimized, cost-effective solutions across our Offshore Wind portfolio.
Represent Application Engineering in cross-functional teams, ensuring stakeholder alignment and successful solution integration.
Coordinate complex technical inputs, including new technologies, throughout the business development and sales cycle.
Manage technical risks, issues, and changes while ensuring clear communication and mitigation plans.
Drive strategy, innovation, and continuous improvement of Offshore Wind processes, tools, and methodologies.
Promote GPQSS offerings and ensure compliance with safety, quality, and business processes.

Your background
Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Power Electronics, or a related field.

Experienced in guiding teams, coordinating complex projects, and fostering a high-performance culture,
Good understanding of grid codes, compliance requirements, and power system studies.
Knowledge of power system analysis, including steady-state, RMS, and EMT simulations using relevant software tools.
Expertise in Offshore Wind project configurations, including WTGs, electrical infrastructure, structural design, control systems, and plant control strategies.
Proven ability to engage customers, build long-term relationships, and balance technical and commercial perspectives in international environments.
